custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test, with a hyphen in its part number, and an active part, part C.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425731 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425731-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425731 PART C in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425731-C in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Create a canned job for this test, canned job A, holding part C and a vendor part typed in by hand whose number is part A's number in lower case with periods in place of its hyphens.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425731 LINE C in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. Add p, a, r, t, , C to that line, one of each: in the line's Parts row click + Add Part, type the part number in Part number, pick the result that shows Inventory Qty, type 1 in Qty *, then click Save. Then, in the line's Parts row, click + Add Part, type zzautotest.pl.c425731.a in Part number, pick the Create … as a new part entry, type a Description and 1 in Qty *, and click Save. Then click the three-dot icon on the line, click Save as canned line, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425731 CANNED JOB A in Line Title and click Save As Canned Line.
  • Set part A inactive after canned job A is saved.
    • How to do it: On the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425731-A, click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window.
  • Create an open work order, work order 1, for this test, with no lines.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: close it with the X at its top right, so the work order has no lines.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
